column3: With respect to the Raymond Center Mortgage Loan (2.2%), the related ESA noted that several dry cleaners have operated on the Mortgaged Property since the 1950s, previous subsurface investigations in 2000 and 2002 identified certain contaminants present in the groundwater exceeding regulatory limits, but not in the soil of the Mortgaged Property and the adjacent property. Accordingly, remediation has been performed, including applying certain chemical oxidation treatments to the impacted groundwater wells and soil and the removal of soil.
